title: sideroxylon obtusifolium
intro: Sideroxylon obtusifolium, commonly known as the Queensland umbrella tree, is a plant species native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antipyretic, an expectorant, and a mucilaginous agent, which helps to reduce fever, relieve cough, and soothe irritated mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Sideroxylon obtusifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
